How to Use the Kratom Ban Tracker

Select a state to see its classification, policy year, summary, and local-ban count. Local action may prohibit manufacturing, sale, or distribution inside a city, county, town, or tribal jurisdiction even where state law otherwise permits kratom.

Use the filters to isolate policy categories and the searchable directory below to locate specific local jurisdictions.

263 Listed Local Kratom Bans

The directory includes municipalities, counties, unincorporated county areas, and tribal jurisdictions in 18 states.

Local measures vary in scope. Some prohibit all manufacturing, sale, or distribution; others target retail sales or particular forms. Verify the operative local rule before relying on this tracker.
